title: LensQi FieldOps site fixture vendor-knowledge binding (overlay)
description: Site-owned overlay that binds one asset in an ExpectedTwin fixture to exactly one knowledge pack and lists the fact IDs verification requires. Cross-file rules enforced by the validator and the runtime loader: the pack must be installed; expectedManufacturerId, expectedProductCode and firmwareMajor must equal the pack identity; every requiredKnowledgeFactIds entry must exist in that pack. Diagnostics are authorized only here, never by a pack.

status.description: Free-text marker for sample files only; the runtime ignores it.

hardwareRevision.description: Confirmed hardware revision of the installed unit, or null when unknown.

firmwareMajor.description: Confirmed firmware major of the installed unit, or null when unknown. Unknown firmware leaves firmware-scoped facts Unverified.

approvedDiagnostics.description: Fixture-approved diagnostic IDs. Each must also exist in the server probe registry before it can run. No URLs, hosts, interface names or credentials.
